title: LightingQuality
description: Which renderer shades the scene. The scene never names one: it describes what emits and what blocks, and the system reports which renderer turned that into pixels. - `forward` shades inside the sprite shader against a capacity-bounded light texture. One draw, no extra targets, and the only renderer that does normal mapping - but every lit fragment walks every light, so the count is capped. - `lightmap` accumulates the lights into a target of their own and multiplies the frame by it. No light cap, shadows from the registered occluder sources, and normals from a prepass over the registered surfaces rather than from a material.
